findings.text: Guest physical activation is offered as a public cache operation that refuses the reserved error address with an invalid argument failure and otherwise delegates to internal activation in address based mode using a distinct bad address sentinel.

Internal activation validates the requested range length first then under refresh exclusion links a previously inactive cache into the virtual machine list before publishing the active flag and finally establishes the mapping for the requested addresses with a consistency check that inactive implies not valid.

Activation holds the per cache refresh mutex across the whole sequence protects the virtual machine wide cache list with its spin lock and publishes the active state under an interrupt saving write lock so concurrent refresh cannot map before notifier reachability.
A distinguished error guest address is reserved to separate address based caches from host address based caches and must never be used as activation input for the address based path.

A central model specific register write handler dispatches guest and host initiated writes by register number to dedicated helpers or direct virtual CPU state updates and reports success versus guest fault versus unsupported operation.
Within each machine check bank the control and status registers are distinguished solely by the low two bits of the register number with control using zero and status using one.

Guest permission to store a nonzero machine check status value exists only for AMD compatible guests that have enabled a particular hardware configuration bit otherwise only clearing to zero or host initiated stores are permitted.

Machine check writes limit the accessible bank range from the low byte of global capability enforce presence bits for global control and threshold support enforce all clear or all set with narrow legacy exceptions for control registers and speculation harden the bank index before storing.

Paravirtual async fault enablement requires reserved bits clear delivery mode consistent with advertised guest features and in kernel interrupt handling and on enable it initializes a shared guest page cache and records the enable value.
Async fault control moves between disabled and enabled where entering enabled wakes all waiters through a queued marker and leaving enabled drains the completion queue and resets duplicate tracking.

Wake all insertion uses a careful lock free empty check for the fast path then under the per virtual CPU async spin lock appends a wake marker to the done list and only the transition from empty outside synchronous mode triggers architecture notification while counting the queued item.
Architecture queued present handling raises an async ready request orders it with a barrier after atomic update and kicks the virtual CPU only when a ready pending flag is not already set.
Async fault interrupt configuration rejects any value with high bits set requires in kernel interrupt handling and stores both the full control value and a masked delivery vector.
Guest allowed dynamic faulting mask is defined as the intersection of the guest supported extended control set with the architecturally defined user dynamic set.

The common register path treats host initiated writes specially by forbidding hypercall page setup from host context allowing microcode revision capability lineage and system management state only from host and relaxing several reserved checks for host callers.

Paravirtual clock async steal and polling registers are each gated by their own guest feature advertisement and on acceptance either record wall and steal state request updates initialize shared pages or clear pending async state with reserved masks enforced.

Prediction and cache flush controls construct their reserved set from both guest advertised features and host capabilities and forward only accepted nonzero values to hardware while ignoring zero writes.

Time stamp and miscellaneous feature writes have side effects rather than plain stores including guest offset adjustment with clock update requests performance capability refresh with intercept recalculation and dynamic CPU identification dirtying on relevant changes.

The common path delegates coherent register groups to dedicated subsystems for memory typing local interrupt base and extended interrupt window machine check performance monitoring and hypervisor enlightenments with pattern validation for cache attributes and masked acceptance for hardware configuration.

Per virtual CPU memory typing state provides a variable range array plus one sixty four kilobyte fixed slot two sixteen kilobyte fixed slots eight four kilobyte fixed slots and a default type field each reachable through register number decoding.

Memory typing validation enforces a narrow mask for default type per byte type checks for fixed ranges and for variable ranges type plus offset reservation on base and low plus reserved guest physical bits on mask.
Only five memory type encodings are accepted namely zero one four five and six with all other values rejected.
Memory typing register update is offered as a public operation that fails for unknown registers or invalid values and otherwise stores the supplied value to the decoded slot.

Performance monitoring register acceptance is determined by vendor callbacks that either map the register to a counter or explicitly approve it and unknown registers fall through to unsupported handling.

Global performance status is read only to guests with host only updates under a reserved mask while global control is validated against its reserved mask and on change triggers counter reprogramming plus forwarding to virtualized hardware when mediation is active with separate clear and set aliases adjusting status.

Writes to per counter registers first record the mapped counter as in use then delegate to vendor handling while control changes accumulate into a pending reprogram mask that is either deferred through a virtual CPU request or handled immediately with empty masks ignored.

Publishing active before list linkage would allow a concurrent refresh to map a cache unreachable by memory notifiers bank index calculation requires speculation hardening and wake marker allocation under atomic context can fail with out of memory leaving state unchanged.
Counter reprogramming uses atomic accumulation into a shared pending mask followed by either a deferred virtual CPU request or direct handling preserving concurrent updates without a sleepable lock.

Async wakeup architecture queued notification memory typing update and performance monitoring query and update are exposed as public cross file operations for use by the common register path and power management flows.
